name: Penn de Calamari Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Goan/Daman style red chili paste
instructions: 1. Boil the penne pasta in salted water until al dente, drain, and set aside.
2. Heat coconut oil in a pan, add curry leaves and onions, and sauté until golden brown.
3. Add ginger-garlic paste and the red chili paste, cooking until the raw smell disappears.
4. Stir in the turmeric and coriander powders, then add the tomato puree and salt, cooking until the oil separates.
5. Add the calamari rings and cook on high heat for 2-3 minutes until tender; do not overcook.
6. Toss the cooked penne pasta into the sauce, ensuring the calamari masala coats the pasta thoroughly.
7. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.
description: This dish reflects the unique culinary landscape of Daman, where traditional Indian spices meet the coastal influence of the Arabian Sea and historical Portuguese culinary footprints, resulting in a vibrant, spicy seafood pasta variant.
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
